# Rewind Dynamics

> Rewind Dynamics is a global defence-technology company established on 26 January 2020. We build autonomous systems and precision guidance for governments and armed forces — unmanned aerial systems (UAV), precision-guided systems and tactical platforms — united by one autonomy core. All systems are under active research and development; our first real-world mission test is planned for December 2026. We are actively raising investment.

## Machine-readable resources

- Full site text: https://rewinddynamics.com/llms-full.txt
- RSS feed: https://rewinddynamics.com/feed.xml
- XML sitemap: https://rewinddynamics.com/sitemap.xml

## About

- Legal entity: Rewind Dynamics LLC (registered in New Mexico, USA)
- Founded: 26 January 2020
- Customers: governments, armed forces, defence programmes and primes, worldwide
- Systems (in R&D): unmanned aerial systems, precision guidance, tactical platforms
- Core capabilities: autonomy, perception, edge AI, GPS-denied navigation, systems engineering
- Applications: ISR, force protection, counter-UAS, tactical edge support
- Research: mother-child nano-drone architecture, swarm autonomy
- Approach: simulation-first, honest after-action assessment, human always in command
- Status: pre-revenue R&D; nothing fielded; first mission test planned December 2026
- Contact: info@ / investors@ / careers@ / partnerships@ / press@ / ethics@ / security@ rewinddynamics.com
